title: Can bad sleep STOP your muscle growth? 😴
caption:
After one night without sleep, muscle building dropped by about 18%, cortisol went up and testosterone went down. How many hours do you sleep? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 6
first_comment: Honest answer: how many hours did you sleep last night? 😴
sources: Lamon S et al. The effect of acute sleep deprivation on skeletal muscle protein synthesis and the hormonal environment. Physiol Rep 2021;9:e14660 (muscle protein synthesis -18%, cortisol +21%, testosterone -24%)
Watson NF et al. Recommended amount of sleep for a healthy adult: a joint consensus statement of the AASM and SRS. Sleep 2015;38:843-844 (7+ hours)
Dattilo M et al. Sleep and muscle recovery: endocrinological and molecular basis for a new and promising hypothesis. Med Hypotheses 2011;77:220-222
